basis: Consolidated · Bosch Limited and its subsidiaries
coverage: Reported business segments · segment revenue before inter-segment revenue
definition: Each segment's revenue less its own costs, before unallocated depreciation, corporate costs, other income, finance costs, exceptional items and tax. The rows add up to ₹2,792.5 crore, which becomes group profit before tax of ₹3,641.7 crore after those items. It is not profit after tax.
location: Annual report 2025–26, PDF page 353 (printed page 351), consolidated statement of profit and loss; PDF pages 403–404 (printed pages 401–402), note 33 segments; PDF page 416 (printed page 414), note 40 exceptional items
notes: Source figures are in ₹ million and were divided by 10. These are the figures of Bosch Limited and its two subsidiaries, not of the wider Bosch India group of 19 companies: the report's headline Bosch India net revenue of ₹40,253.0 crore covers that wider group, whereas Bosch Limited's own revenue from contracts with customers is ₹20,034.7 crore. Segment revenue of ₹20,071.9 crore is before ₹37.2 crore of inter-segment revenue in Others; after it, revenue is ₹20,034.7 crore. Automotive Products covers diesel systems, gasoline systems and automotive aftermarket products and services; Consumer Goods is mainly trading in power tools and consumables. Group profit after tax is ₹2,773.2 crore, which includes a one-off ₹556.0 crore gain from selling the video solutions, access and intrusion and communication systems business to Keenfinity India Private Limited on 1 May 2025 (shown as an exceptional item). Total income including other income of ₹854.0 crore is ₹20,888.7 crore. Bosch does not disclose profit for any single product line inside a segment.
insight: Automotive Products brings in most of the segment revenue and most of the segment result. Group profit also includes other income that belongs to no segment and a one-off gain from selling a business.
